section_summary.extract_value: This abstract reports a single study (Study X) evaluating the psychometric properties and factor structure of the Persian BAS-2. Participants were 568 men and 525 women from seven universities in Tehran, Iran; the Persian BAS-2 showed a one-factor solution, satisfactory convergent validity and internal consistency, and men scored higher than women.
